title: Animated Eyes Overhaul
description: Adds blinking eye animations to various Minecraft items and blocks while keeping the vanilla style.
body:
Animated Eye Overhaul brings life to Minecraft's eye-themed items and blocks with smooth blinking animations.

Features:
• Animated Ender Eye & Pearl
• Blinking Trial Keys & Trial Spawners
• Animated Fish Buckets
• Animated Spawner Eyes
• Additional eye-themed animations
• Vanilla-friendly design
• Lightweight and performance-friendly

This pack enhances existing textures with subtle animations while preserving Minecraft's original look and feel.
